title: Can AI Mature a Model's Geometry? Training-Free Weight Baking in LLMs
domain: representation geometry / latent-space organisation of LLMs
tasks_benchmarks: WordNet category probe words (purity, silhouette, anisotropy, Betti numbers)

headline_result.text: An LLM analyst reading only a fixed-size topological digest proposed edits that ridge regression baked into feed-forward weights; across 126 runs category purity rose on unseen words and sentence frames (about +0.01 to +0.03) with benchmark accuracy within sampling error, matching a deterministic heuristic with gentler edits.
headline_result.quote: 126 runs show that category purity rose on unseen words and sentences, benchmark accuracy stayed within sampling error, and the analyst matched a category-aware heuristic with gentler edits.

evidence_quality.n_runs_or_seeds: 3 seeds (data-split resamples on the same frozen weights); round robin single seed

key_claims.claim: The method deliberately avoids raw-weight WSP because raw weights do not fit in an LLM context; the analyst sees a compact digest instead.
key_claims.quote: Weight-Space Programming lets a frontier large language model (LLM) read and write raw weights as text, but a 1.5-million-parameter network already exceeds the model’s context [6].

key_claims.claim: The analyst and a category-aware heuristic were comparable in purity gain; the analyst used less of the divergence budget.
key_claims.quote: On the same target and seed, the analyst’s purity gain under [D] was higher than the default heuristic’s in three of the six pairs and lower in three, so the two arms are comparable in effectiveness.

key_claims.claim: Tuned heuristic configurations matched or beat the default analyst on Qwen.
key_claims.quote: Two tuned heuristic configurations from the ablations (Table 3) matched or exceeded the default analyst on Qwen in purity gain, CKA, KL, and held-out perplexity, while the analyst kept the larger silhouette gain.

key_claims.claim: In the five-model round robin, 16 of 20 analyst-target pairs changed the target and all 16 raised purity; analyst gain did not grow with parameter count.
key_claims.quote: In 16 of the 20 pairs the analyst changed its target, and in all 16 purity under [D] rose over the edited layers

key_claims.claim: Edits came at a cost in held-out perplexity and factual margin.
key_claims.quote: The truth margin of the factual probe fell in all 18 default runs, by at most 8.1% of the baseline margin

limitations_stated.text: Seeds resample data splits on the same frozen weights, so statistics are descriptive, and the analyst's rationales are short and generic.
limitations_stated.quote: the three seeds resample data splits and benchmark samples on the same frozen weights, so the statistics are descriptive

limitations_stated.text: Steering and closed-form editing baselines were not run.
limitations_stated.quote: The open questions are how far the paradigm scales and how it compares with the steering and closed-form editing baselines of Section 2, which we did not run.

limitations_stated.text: Most accepted analyst edits passed only at a relaxed gain threshold that also admits neutral edits.
limitations_stated.quote: Most of the analyst’s accepted edits passed only at the relaxed gain threshold, which admits very small gains and, in two cases of the main study, neutral edits

notes_for_review: A WSP-adjacent variant: small LLMs (1.5-3.8B) never read raw weights but choose from four affine operations given a topological digest, and closed-form ridge regression writes the change into feed-forward weights. Gains in latent 'purity' are small, a deterministic heuristic does about as well (tuned versions better), and most accepted edits passed only a relaxed near-zero threshold, so the evidence that the LLM adds value is weak. Behavioural metrics show small costs (perplexity up 6-9%, truth margin down), no random-direction control was run, and only 200-example benchmark subsamples were used.
